name: hash-sha256-short
algorithm: std SHA-256 over every 64-byte message of splitmix64 bytes, reps passes with a one-byte write-back (mk/hash-sha256-short.mk).

skip.c: no std hash: C has no standard SHA-256
skip.rust: no std SHA-256: Rust std has none (only SipHash-1-3 in DefaultHasher); no crate stands in

notes: Idiomatic standard library, the short-message case (HMAC, Ed25519, tree nodes; review finding HMR-3): one one-shot call per 64-byte message, so the per-call setup, the padding block and Sum are measured, not only the block loop. Messages per second = mib * 1048576 / 64 * reps / median.
Go: crypto/sha256.Sum256 uses the SHA extensions (SHA-NI) or AVX2 on amd64 when the CPU has them; Mk is scalar. Zig at -mcpu=x86_64_v2 is scalar.

Checksums: Mk (mk build -release), Zig 0.17.0 (-O ReleaseFast -mcpu=x86_64_v2) and, where it has the function, Go 1.27.3 (GOAMD64=v2 -pgo=off) printed the same quick values on the owner's machine, 2026-11-07 (std-hashmod session 9, HMR-3); the publish-size checksum was agreed by every column in `go run ./tools/bench verify -publish-size`. Not published: no number here is a measurement.
